ITA-9.5.3 śalākā शलाका
Ophthalmic probe
A probe used for various procedures in diseases of the head and neck region .

ITA-9.6.12 śalākāyantram शलाकायन्त्रम्
Blunt, probe-like instruments
Instruments used in surgical and parasurgical procedures such as probing, mobilization, extraction and the application of medications.

ITA-9.6.195 śalyam शल्यम्
Foreign body or substance that must be removed surgically or by other means
Any foreign body or factor which discomfits or obstructs the body and mind.

ITA-9.6.199 śalyagatiḥ शल्यगतिः
Route of foreign body entry and movement
Site of entry and movement of a foreign body in affected body tissue.

śalyacikitsā शल्यचिकित्सा
Surgery
The clinical speciality of Ayurveda dealing with the removal of internal or external foreign bodies (shalya) through surgical intervention(s).

ITA-9.6.1 śalyatantram शल्यतन्त्रम्
Surgery
One of the eight clinical branches of Āyurveda which deals with surgery.

ITA-5.56.6 śalyanimittajanāḍīvraṇaḥ शल्यनिमित्तजनाडीव्रणः
Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to injury with foreign body
A sinus ulcer characterized by a frothy clear discharge as if churned; sanguineous discharge; warm discharge; constant pain; blood-mixed pus discharge; thin discharge; reduced quantity of discharge, e.g. pilonidal sinus.

ITA-5.76.66 śalyārdita-virecanavyāpat शल्यार्दित-विरेचनव्यापत्
Condition caused by purgation therapy administered to person afflicated with foreign body
A condition characterized by vata localized in the injured part leading to death.

ITA-9.5.2 śālākin/ śalākī शालाकिन्/शलाकी
Specialist in diseases of the head and neck region
A person who has expertise and practice in diagnosing and treating diseases of the head and neck or śalākāyantraṁ.

ITA-5.74.10 śālidhānya-atiyogaḥ शालिधान्य-अतियोगः
Disorder due to excessive intake of cereals, e.g. rice

śālisaktuḥ शालिसक्तुः
Flour of roasted rice
A dietetic preparation made by adding sugar and water to the flour of roasted rice.
